authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Dock centerline aligns with shore route. Dock deck is level with shore in default navigable variant; water, banks, and edge zones are non-walkable. Railings or conservative movement bounds protect exposed edges; no diving/jumping path. Target bounding dimensions 24m wide x 0.3m high x 22m deep. Materials: wood-weathered. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
